_comment: Every generated asset in this project, with the exact prompt and seed that
produced it. Regenerating one asset or all of them is one command, and a
diff on this file shows precisely what changed about the art.
Sizes here are GENERATION sizes and must be multiples of 64 (LayerDiffuse
fails to decode otherwise). The 'target' field is the final size the asset
is downscaled to for the game - see art/SPECS.md for where each comes from.

defaults.negative: drop shadow, cast shadow, ground shadow, reflection, background, backdrop, scenery, text, watermark, signature, frame, border, blurry, jpeg artifacts, multiple objects

assets.name: rock_floor
assets.prompt: isometric diamond ground tile, cracked grey rock and rubble surface, top-down 2:1 isometric projection, painted game art, even flat lighting, seamless edges
assets.notes: 2:1 diamond, corners at edge midpoints. Upper-left edge must tile against lower-right. No feather on diamond edges.

assets.name: water
assets.prompt: isometric diamond water tile, shallow rippling water surface, teal and blue, top-down 2:1 isometric projection, painted game art, even flat lighting, seamless edges
assets.notes: Same diamond spec as rock_floor. See caveat in SPECS.md - iso_ground.gd takes one texture per corridor, so rock+water together needs a code change.

assets.name: background
assets.prompt: distant post-apocalyptic horizon, hazy sky, faded hills and ruined skyline, muted desaturated palette, painted game backdrop, no foreground detail
assets.notes: Must tile seamlessly in BOTH axes - the camera drifts diagonally as the car moves along the corridor.
